weeks.say: Method note: the plated volume was five pipette draws with water reaching the bulb. Calibrated afterwards against a test tube, three such draws consistently measure 5 mL, so each plate received about 8.3 mL and the value here uses the measured volume (multiplier 12, not the nominal 20). The red call is unchanged. Draws are stopped at the 1 mL stem mark from week 3 on. Incubation note: the plate spent about an hour at room temperature before the incubator, close to the usual gel-set wait, then 24 hours at 35 C as planned. The count is not expected to be affected.

First reading from the project’s own rain gauge at the boathouse: 0.00 in in the 48 hours before the sample, so this week’s number is no longer attributed to an airport three miles away. Plated volume was confirmed at a true 5 mL this time, so the standard multiplier of 20 applies with no correction needed. The counts here are a co-pilot estimate from backlit photographs, not yet independently verified against the physical plates.
